---
title: "Where ADRD diagnoses fall relative to the measurement occasions"
output: html_notebook
author: Karolina Gustavsson
date: 2026-09-09
---

Input data: `results_dt` from `Calculating_BA_L.Rmd` (one row per measurement
occasion), restricted to individuals with an ADRD diagnosis.

Reviewer point: immortal person-time in the longitudinal cohort. Inclusion
previously required only that an individual was free of ADRD at the *first*
measurement, which leaves people who were diagnosed before contributing three
measurements. This notebook counts where the diagnosis falls -- at the first,
a middle, or the last measurement occasion -- which is what the revised
inclusion rule needed before it could be applied.

The counts this notebook prints are the basis for the revised inclusion
criteria stated in the Methods, under which 61 of 44,866 individuals are
excluded for having fewer than three pre-diagnosis measurements, leaving
44,805.

The rule itself is applied in `Longitudinal/BA_rate_L.Rmd`; this notebook only
describes the data it was derived from.

# 1.0 Position of the diagnosis within each individual's measurement series
```{r}
analysis_df <- results_dt %>%
  filter(ADRD == 1) %>%
  arrange(sampleID, age) %>%      # make sure rows are in chronological order per person
  group_by(sampleID) %>%
  mutate(
    row_num = row_number(),
    total_rows = n(),
    adrd_age = first(AgeAtLastDate),
    next_age = lead(age),
    valid_adrd_row = adrd_age >= age & (is.na(next_age) | adrd_age <= next_age)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    num_rows = first(total_rows),
    adrd_age = first(adrd_age),
    has_valid_adrd_row = any(valid_adrd_row),
    adrd_at_first = any(valid_adrd_row & row_num == 1),
    adrd_at_last = any(valid_adrd_row & row_num == total_rows),
    adrd_in_middle = any(valid_adrd_row & row_num > 1 & row_num < total_rows),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat("People with valid ADRD row found:", sum(analysis_df$has_valid_adrd_row), "\n")
cat("ADRD at first row:", sum(analysis_df$adrd_at_first), "\n")
cat("ADRD in middle rows:", sum(analysis_df$adrd_in_middle), "\n")
cat("ADRD at last row:", sum(analysis_df$adrd_at_last), "\n")
cat("Missing/no valid row found:", sum(!analysis_df$has_valid_adrd_row), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Get the sampleIDs in each category
first_ids  <- analysis_df %>% filter(adrd_at_first)  %>% pull(sampleID)
middle_ids <- analysis_df %>% filter(adrd_in_middle) %>% pull(sampleID)
last_ids   <- analysis_df %>% filter(adrd_at_last)   %>% pull(sampleID)

# Full records (all columns, all rows) for each group
adrd_first_df  <- results_dt %>% filter(sampleID %in% first_ids)  %>% arrange(sampleID, age)
adrd_middle_df <- results_dt %>% filter(sampleID %in% middle_ids) %>% arrange(sampleID, age)
adrd_last_df   <- results_dt %>% filter(sampleID %in% last_ids)   %>% arrange(sampleID, age)

# quick counts to sanity check against analysis_df
cat("First-row ADRD people:", length(first_ids), "\n")
cat("Middle-row ADRD people:", length(middle_ids), "\n")
cat("Last-row ADRD people:", length(last_ids), "\n")

# inspect a few
View(adrd_first_df)
View(adrd_middle_df)

#First-row ADRD people: 25 (these are techniqually middle)
#Middle-row ADRD people: 85 
#Last-row ADRD people: 5515 

# so 110/5515, 2%
```
